candidates.change_summary: Delete the withdraw call inside withdrawAll, so the function no longer transfers balance but still exists.
Replace withdraw with a call using a hardcoded zero amount, so the balance is never transferred.
Delete the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll, allowing anyone to call it and change the contract balance.
Replace the transfer call with a selfdestruct to effectively change the balance without updating owner's balance correctly, altering the outcome of withdraw.
Change the recipient of the transfer to a hardcoded zero address, burning the funds instead of sending to owner.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw does not actually move any funds.
Replace the transfer with a transfer of zero wei regardless of _value argument.
Replace the onlyOwner modifier check with an always-true condition, removing access control.
Remove the require check on msg.sender, making the modifier publicly callable by any address.
Delete the require that checks the return value of the low-level call, so the function succeeds even when the call fails.
Insert a state variable update setting depositsCount to 0 before the call, changing the depositsCount value observably after sendMoney completes.
Replace the call target with msg.sender so funds are sent to the caller instead of the supplied target.
Replace the call value with the full contract balance, changing the amount sent to _target.
